To form a valid orthonormal frame where $\mathbf{e}_z$ is the normal to the plane of centers, $\mathbf{e}_y$ must be orthogonal to both $\mathbf{e}_x$ and $\mathbf{e}_z$.
The standard construction is $\mathbf{e}_y = \mathbf{e}_z \times \mathbf{e}_x$ (or $\mathbf{e}_x \times \mathbf{e}_z$ depending on handedness).
